enemies.name: Goblin

lore.title: Brute's hide
lore.text: Scrawled on a scrap of hide: "Brute wears only his own skin. Cut him and he bleeds like the rest of us. Keep your edge sharp."

enemies.lossHint: Goblins are weak alone. Try again: a better weapon helps.

enemies.name: Goblin brute

lore.title: Bear sign
lore.text: A hunter's tally stick, notched: "The old one's coat is thick as a quilted jerkin. Blades slide off. A spear point goes through."

enemies.flavour: Goblin brute: twice the size, half the patience.
enemies.lossHint: Brutes hit hard. A hide vest and a copper sword make the difference.

enemies.name: Old Bear
enemies.flavour: Old Bear: it was here before the goblins. It will be here after.
enemies.lossHint: The Old Bear is quick and hits hard. Come back much stronger.

enemies.name: Skeleton

lore.title: Gravedigger's note
lore.text: "They rot soft under the shroud. No armour, just meat. A clean cut ends them; a club only makes them angry." The rest is mud.

enemies.flavour: Skeleton: nothing to hurt but bone, and bone is hard.
enemies.lossHint: Skeletons shrug off weak blows. A stronger weapon helps.

enemies.name: Zombie

lore.title: The King's armour
lore.text: Torn from a sexton's ledger: "His Majesty was buried in full plate. Swords ring off it. The old smith says only a hammer cracks a king."

enemies.flavour: Zombie: slow, but it never stops coming.
enemies.lossHint: Zombies are slow but hit hard, and fights are long. Defence helps: try a shield.

enemies.name: Graveyard King

lore.title: Wolf pelts
lore.text: A royal decree, half eaten: "...bounty on the grey wolves of the moor. Their pelts turn nothing. Any blade will do..."

enemies.flavour: Graveyard King: he ruled once. He still thinks he does.
enemies.lossHint: The Graveyard King's armour is heavy: a stronger weapon helps. Bring a shield and body armour too.

enemies.name: Wolf

lore.title: Mist on the moor
lore.text: A shepherd's charm with a note tied on: "The pale ones wear nothing at all. Swing wide, swing true; a blade parts them like fog."

enemies.flavour: Wolf: it bites before you've drawn your sword.
enemies.lossHint: Wolves strike first. More defence and HP help.

enemies.name: Ghost

lore.title: Wanted poster
lore.text: A faded poster: "Bandits of the ridge, armed and in leather coats. Reward for each. Pikemen preferred: the leather won't stop a thrust."

enemies.flavour: Ghost: your armour means nothing to it.
enemies.lossHint: Ghosts pass through armour. More HP and a faster kill help.

enemies.name: Bandit

lore.title: Stolen map
lore.text: A bandit's map, the pass circled: "Spiders there. Hard shells like boiled leather. Stab between the plates, don't hack."

enemies.lossHint: Bandits hit very hard but go down fast. Defence helps.

enemies.name: Giant spider

lore.title: Silk-wrapped letter
lore.text: Found in a cocoon: "Trolls wear no armour, only their own grey hide. Cut deep and fast, before it closes." The writer did not finish.

enemies.flavour: Giant spider: you see the legs before the rest.
enemies.lossHint: Spiders strike first and hard. Defence helps.

enemies.name: Troll

lore.title: Toll receipt
lore.text: A greasy receipt: "Paid the Chieftain. Saw his coat up close: layered leather and hide. Arrows and spears are what he fears."

enemies.flavour: Troll: cut it and it closes. Cut it faster.
enemies.lossHint: Trolls heal every round. A big weapon beats the healing.

enemies.name: Ogre Chieftain

lore.title: Chieftain's boast
lore.text: Carved in the bridge stones: "Ogres fear no stone man. We break them with mauls. Swords? Ha. Swords break."

enemies.flavour: Ogre Chieftain: the bridge is his. So is the toll.
enemies.lossHint: The Ogre Chieftain is slow, but every blow crushes. Bring iron and troll gear.

enemies.name: Stone golem

lore.title: Mason's warning
lore.text: Chiselled inside a golem's core: "The bird-women wear feathers, nothing more. A sweeping blade brings them down."

enemies.flavour: Stone golem: a mountain that learned to walk.
enemies.lossHint: Golems are almost unbreakable. Bring your best weapon.

enemies.name: Harpy

lore.title: Feather quill note
lore.text: Written with a harpy quill: "The wraiths wrap themselves in grave-leather and old cloth. Pierce it. Cutting only tears rags."

enemies.flavour: Harpy: it dives from the sun, claws first.
enemies.lossHint: Harpies strike first, and their claws ignore armour. More HP helps.

enemies.name: Wraith

lore.title: Cold letter
lore.text: Frost on the paper: "The wyvern's scales overlap like a brigandine. A lance finds the gaps; a sword glances off."

enemies.flavour: Wraith: cold hands, and it mends as it fights.
enemies.lossHint: Wraiths ignore armour and heal. A big weapon and lots of HP help.

enemies.name: Wyvern

lore.title: Scorched page
lore.text: A scorched page from a dragon-hunter's book: "Drakes are plated like knights. Bring a hammer. Spears snap on them."

enemies.flavour: Wyvern: a dragon's little cousin, and just as rude.
enemies.lossHint: Wyverns strike first and hard. Defence helps.

enemies.name: Fire drake

lore.title: The dragon-hunter's last page
lore.text: "The young one's scales are thicker still, heavy as a cathedral door. Only crushing blows carry through. I did not bring one."

enemies.flavour: Fire drake: armoured, burning, and healing in its own fire.
enemies.lossHint: Drakes are armoured and heal. Bring your biggest weapon.

enemies.name: Young Dragon
enemies.flavour: Young Dragon: young for a dragon. Old for everything else.
enemies.lossHint: The Young Dragon is quick, armoured, heals and hits hard. Bring the full mithril set.
